# Feature Request

## Summary

Briefly describe the feature or improvement you're proposing.

## Problem It Solves

What problem does this address? Which user (Customer, Agent, Admin) benefits?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the behavior or workflow you would like.

## Alternative Approaches

Describe any other solutions or features you considered.

## Scope

- [ ] Customer-facing (mobile app)
- [ ] Agent-facing (mobile app)
- [ ] Admin-facing (web portal)
- [ ] Shared package (`packages/shared`)
- [ ] Firestore schema, Rules, or indexes
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Repository tooling

## Impact on Existing Documentation

Does this change any of the following? Check all that apply.

- [ ] PRD
- [ ] Requirements Checklist
- [ ] System Architecture
- [ ] Database Design
- [ ] RBAC & Security (including `firestore.rules`)
- [ ] User Flow Diagram
- [ ] Request Lifecycle / State Diagram
- [ ] UI/UX Wireframes
- [ ] Testing Plan
- [ ] README / Setup & Deployment

If any are checked, note what needs updating.

## Free-Tier Compatibility

QuickServe runs on Firebase Spark only. Confirm this feature:

- [ ] Does not require Cloud Functions, Blaze billing, or a paid service.
- [ ] Does not require non-Flutter UI frameworks.
- [ ] Does not introduce custom Firebase Authentication claims.
- [ ] Does not require FCM or another paid notification service.

If any of these cannot be confirmed, explain.

## Additional Context

Anything else that would help evaluate this feature: mockups, references, examples.
